worldcombat.skill.nightshade.summary: A ranged frightening mirage: condense part of your level into a phantom and hurl it; the phantom homes on the target, burrows into its mind for fixed damage equal to your level, then lingers a moment. The target never moves; the splash form spreads one strike into an area burst, each hit lighter.
worldcombat.skill.nightshade.description: The strike deals %1$s fixed damage: your level times a small special-attack factor. The target's defence does not matter; only type immunity stops it.
Prepare %1$s s; the phantom reaches %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks/tick (it homes on the target) with a %4$s block hit radius.
worldcombat.skill.nightshade.splash.on: Splash form: on impact it reaches up to %2$s enemies within %1$s blocks, each hit reduced to 55 percent damage and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.nightshade.splash.off: Single form: only the target that was hit, at full damage.
worldcombat.skill.nightshade.timing: Range %1$s blocks; prepare %2$s s, recover %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, cost %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.nightshade.use.0: Wear a foe down with level damage from afar
worldcombat.skill.nightshade.use.1: Let the phantom chase a running enemy
worldcombat.skill.nightshade.use.2: Clear a cluster with the splash form
On: burst on impact and reach several nearby enemies, but each hit drops to 55 share and the cooldown is longer. Off: single target, full damage.
Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of casting; larger lets it strike from further out.
Prefer this cast when at least this many enemies stand around the target (pairs with the splash form); larger means it only casts in dense groups.
When on, the user may leave its post to find a firing position; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
worldcombat.skill.nightshade.growth.1: From level %1$s the splash radius widens to %2$s blocks.
